name: echr-lookup
description: Ask questions of UK–ECHR case law; every claim cites the exact paragraph.

scripts.dev:api: cd py && uv run --group ml uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port ${API_PORT:-8000}
scripts.ingest:snapshot: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m rag.ingest --source snapshot
scripts.ingest:full: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m rag.ingest --source full
scripts.search: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m rag.search
scripts.ask: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m rag.answer
scripts.mcp:stdio: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m echr_mcp --transport stdio
scripts.mcp:http: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m echr_mcp --transport http --port ${MCP_PORT:-8100}
scripts.eval:snapshot: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m rag.eval --source snapshot
scripts.eval:agentic: cd py && uv run --group ml python -m rag.eval.agentic
scripts.check:ts: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.check:py: cd py && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run pytest -q
